propositions: Three near-identical replacement link walkers exist across close_precheck.py and close_disposition.py that differ only in liveness check and return type.

The consolidation unifies the duplicates/supersedes walk into a single close_disposition.replacement_of() function with require_live parameter while preserving class-guard differences via wrapper seams.
A construct-uniqueness guard test scans src/rebar for the conjunction of find_inbound_relationships and supersedes outside close_disposition.py and enforces a reasoned escape marker.
DISPOSITION_CLASSES and _NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be the same object so the non-bug ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing is preserved and the two sets cannot drift.
The three monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement retain their original names and signatures as wrappers calling the shared core.
